contracts: (Acceptance is reachable only when independent verification records effective=true for the intended target; mismatch blocks reliance.) AND (Acceptance requires every applicable Consumer to have successful disable evidence from its concrete real call surface.) AND (Acceptance requires independent verification of every listed non-authority binding.) AND (Aggregate output marks failure and lists every missing required Matrix Case or subject execution; no incomplete set can be accepted.) AND (Aggregate validation output contains invalid status, a non-empty reused-evidence finding, and acceptance=false; any accepted result with reused evidence fails.) AND (Any reused evidence identity causes a deterministic non-success result with an explicit reuse reason.) AND (Exactly six distinct case IDs each have records for both subjects; otherwise aggregate result is non-success.) AND (For the selected adversarial dependency case, the semantic gate emits a non-success verdict whose determining evidence identifies the dependency violation; any success verdict fails the check.) AND (No replay result is accepted unless its recorded Current Snapshot identity resolves to a complete required-content manifest and the association is verified by the replay contract test.) AND (Success is emitted only when an independently generated verification record covers and passes every declared dependency.) AND (Successful evidence is valid only when its content identity and digest equal the effective inspected content inspected in the same run.) AND (The integration trace proves the applicable Consumer's real re-enable success and restoration checks.) AND (The rollback verification report covers every non-empty Consumer Manifest entry exactly once and records 100% baseline matches; any mismatch fails the obligation.) AND (Verdict acceptance requires matching current source identity plus real execution evidence; prose alone can never satisfy the predicate.)
selector_intents: Alter one non-authority binding identity and verify the independent verifier rejects the result.
Delete the independent verification record while leaving replay success true and verify acceptance fails.
Exercise rollback with a non-empty Consumer Manifest entry whose observed behavior differs from the Prior Behavior Baseline; the verification must fail and identify that entry.
Provide a verdict with assistant prose but omit or invalidate source identity or real execution evidence; validator must reject acceptance.
Provide two Matrix Case records referencing the same evidence identity and run aggregate validation; the validator must mark the aggregate invalid and deny acceptance.
Remove one required Matrix Case subject execution from the evaluation input and run the aggregate evaluator; it must return a failed aggregate with the missing execution identified.
Replay evidence validation against altered effective content or a mismatched digest; validator must reject the successful evidence.
Return success while omitting or falsifying the independent dependency-verification record and verify acceptance fails.
Route disable through a mock or simulated Consumer and verify real-call-surface assertion fails.
Run the Matrix evaluator with one case missing one subject execution; aggregate evaluation must return non-success.
Select a replay-result fixture whose current snapshot manifest omits a required file or binding identity; the replay validator must reject the result as incomplete.
Select the adversarial dependency fixture that would otherwise yield success; execute the semantic gate and require a non-success verdict identifying the dependency violation.
Select the reused-evidence fixture and evaluate it; the evaluator must deterministically return non-success.
Skip disable invocation and verify successful Consumer evidence is absent.
Use a fixture whose inspected path or bytes differ from the intended target identity; independent verification must fail closed.
Use the existing skill replay lifecycle test selector with a trace missing real re-enable or containing simulated-only re-enable; integration validation must fail.
